messages:
Anya: Quick sync before we lock GA for the pilot cohort at 18:00 PT. Minimal acceptance: SLA doc, pilot contract terms, pricing FAQ, billing smoke, runbook with fallback, monitoring + alerting, legal nod. Who takes what? :eyes:
Raj: I can own pilot contract and pricing FAQ. Will add explicit overage/refund language and a short examples section.
Tess: I'll handle SLA doc + oncall rota. Proposing SLOs: 99.9% uptime, p95 <= 800ms, error rate < 0.5%. Will add escalation chart.
Priya: Runbooks + monitoring alerts. Suggest alerts: p95 > 900ms (P0), error_rate > 0.6% (P0), token_cost_variance > 15% (P1). I'll include trace sampling for first 48h.
Anya: Ops question: Do we have a documented fallback flow to route to a quantized variant and a rollback curl we can give support? Need exact commands.
Raj: Billing team has `pilot_kv_override` flag. I'll add the example billing command in the FAQ.
Tess: I'll author a rollback snippet into the runbook. Example:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.redwood/api/v1/rollout -d '{"strategy":"quantized-fallback","reason":"latency_spike"}'
```
Priya: ops-bot can run the billing smoke once Raj pushes the FAQ link.
ops-bot: scheduled job `pilot-billing-smoke-187654` for 2025-06-10T03:15:00Z; will report result here.
Raj: Pushed FAQ and sample invoice expectations to docs/pricing/pilot_faq.md. Includes rounding rules and overage caps.
ops-bot: pilot-billing-smoke-187654 completed: PASS. invoice_event=1 expected=1. cost_diff=0.0. logs=https://logs.redwood/smoke/187654
Anya: Great. Legal asked for a one-line risk clause on data residency; Raj can you add and ping legal?
Raj: Yep, added clause and notified legal. Ticket LEG-232 opened.
Tess: SLA doc and oncall rota PR up. Includes rollback and canary steps.
Priya: Runbook updated and monitoring alerts created in prod-config. I'll watch burn-in and adjust thresholds if noisy.
Anya: Owners recap: Raj (pricing/contract/legal ping), Tess (SLA/oncall/rollback), Priya (runbook/monitoring), Anya (release announcement + shiproom contact). If all green by 17:30 PT we go GA; else amber and escalate. :shipit:
Tess: Acknowledged. I'll be standing by for merge conflicts.
Raj: I'll merge pricing/FAQ after one more review.
Anya: Thanks teamWill post final status at 17:35 PT in #all-hands.
